choice_data_list: Were you up late last night?
Were you up late last night?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...What's so wrong with spendin' time 
workin' when I can't fall asleep easily 
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*, ah... Just... stay out of this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to fall asleep, she ended up 
staying awake the whole night... Air 
Shakur looked completely exhausted all 
day.
